gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ar: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine, and every stroke looks drawn with a single stylus. Noto Sans Old South Arabian follows in a friendly sans-serif, its curves finishing before they turn inward, so paragraphs read cleanly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ojuju: Ojuju has the mild contrast of a lightly flexed spring wire, with wide s curves barely curled in at the ends. Bellota is the one that commands attention; Ojuju simply keeps going.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-overpass: Modern and confident, Overpass never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes within a word, and its e is never a blot. And Bellota above it keeps its curves as thick as its stems, so lines move along steadily.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-palanquin: Round, open and quietly sharp: Palanquin's curved letters have wide, unclosed mouths, while Bellota cuts everything at a single engraver's depth. That shared openness is what ties them.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-philosopher: Bellota feels like blueprint lettering, one constant line from start to finish. Philosopher softens that with roomy curves and gentle thickness shifts, so a plain sans body at a modest size reads comfortably.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-pontano-sans: Pontano Sans reads openly and contemporary, its c terminals wide and inviting in a sans-serif body. But Bellota's rounds and stems share one weight, and that uniform, distinctive line is the pair's real signature.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans gives its c forms the look of open arcs, a friendly plain sans with a professional manner. Bellota's identical bar thickness carries the headline; PT Sans handles the reading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-quattrocento-sans: Bold, hanging-ended curves and no brush-like pressure swelling anywhere: that is Bellota, distinctive and uniform in line. It earns its keep big and short, while Quattrocento Sans keeps its c clearly apart from an o.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-red-hat-text: Bellota is a commanding display face with hanging s ends. Red Hat Text, a plain sans with the line weight of a technical drawing pen and curvy, unclamped letters, gives that voice a friendly, modern follow-through.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans gives its e a wide gap at the terminal and keeps its thickness constant in every direction. And Bellota's stylus-width strokes lead above it, so a long page of this sans-serif body flows without friction.
